title: Trade gold flow: typed amount never leaves the client on the accept wire — 0x7EE lparam ignored by both receivers (0x404600/0x45A140), msg 0x406 header-only (format 0x47C800 "#%d%s!", zero payload), msg 0x405 sender doubly dead (gate 0x417280 unreachable), msg 0x3F8 is the only static gold-amount send (32-bit header dword0, runtime bound [obj+0x35B1E8]), 0x7DA100 = loader-zeroed dead config slot (unused trade/purchase gold limit [INFERENCE])
objective: Close the trade-gold pending item of inventory-window-render-evidence.json (semantic name of 0x7DA100, candidate 'trade/buy quantity cap') by tracing the complete outbound gold flow in this build: (a) the 0x7EE chat-line handoff of the typed amount, (b) the msg 0x406 trade-accept wire contents, (c) the msg 0x405 dead gate vs the live msg 0x3F8 gold command, (d) the dead-config-slot status and intended semantic of 0x7DA100. Builds on EI-288 (send-site reconciliation, 0x7DA100 zero-writer proof), EI-284/EI-287 (trade-window gold box, accept click, finalize flag).
question: Where does the trade-gold amount actually go after it is typed? Does msg 0x406 (accept) or the legacy msg 0x405 carry the amount on the wire? Do the 0x7EE receivers consume the lparam that holds the typed text? Is 0x7DA100 a live bound or a dead slot, and what was its intended semantic?
method: Primary-static disassembly of /tmp/nas_mnt/NAS/TMP/EI传奇3.0客户端/Mir3.exe (VA base 0x400000) via Tools/reverse-engineering/disasm_capstone.py plus custom capstone scans over .text and the full PE image. Full disassembly of: 0x404600 and 0x45A140 (0x7EE receivers, argument-usage analysis), 0x4185CB region (0x7EE sender, GetWindowTextA into obj+0x130), 0x41CDE0 (chat-command handler, switch table 0x41CED8), 0x41E4xx custom-msg dispatcher (table 0x41E690), 0x42D680 trade router (jump table 0x42D700 read as dwords), 0x417280 gate, 0x451B00/0x451B30/0x451940 (0x405/0x406/0x3F8 senders), 0x452940 header builder, 0x451E60 wire builder (counter wrap, header copy, payload branch, send via 0x468098), 0x417034 trade accept, 0x42EE4C bag gold paint read. Whole-image raw LE-byte scan (00 A1 7D 00) for 0x7DA100 references; PE section-table check that 0x7DA100 lies in the virtual-only tail of .data (file-backed .data ends at VA 0x47F000, virtual size 0x49EFD4, so the loader zero-fills it); rel32 call xref scans (E8) for the three senders and the gate.

seven_ee_handoff.sender: 0x4185CB region (chat-line submit): GetWindowTextA(0x8AA48C, obj+0x130, 0x104) at 0x4185AC copies the typed line (e.g. gold command text) into the game object; SetWindowTextA(0x8AA48C, 0x8B187C='') at 0x4185BE clears the input; SendMessageA([0x8AB7B0], 0x7EE, wparam=ebp, lparam=&obj+0x130) at 0x4185DB (push edi(lparam); push ebp(wparam); push 0x7EE; push eax(main)); [0x8AA498]=1; call 0x417FB0; ret 8. Trigger: chat-input key handler 0x403FE0 (arg3==0xD ENTER / 0x9 TAB) via 0x418470/0x418400 chain.
seven_ee_handoff.receiver_1: 0x404600 (dispatched from main wndproc 0x403E81's 0x7EE case): reads NO arguments ([esp+4]/[esp+8] untouched, ret 8). If [obj+0x8A4]==1: memset(obj+0xE3D, 0, 260B), SetWindowTextA(0x8AA48C, obj+0xD39) (history restore), [obj+0xD38]=1, call 0x403640 (chat-line restore/reposition: MoveWindow + ShowWindow + SendMessageA(0x8AA48C, 0xCC, ...)), [0x8AA498]=0.
seven_ee_handoff.receiver_2: 0x45A140 (also dispatched from 0x403E81's 0x7EE case): reads ONLY [esp+4] wparam (ret 8; lparam never touched). type=(wparam>>16)&0xFF, arg=wparam&0xFF; type==1 && arg==0 && [obj+0x1168] in -1..1 -> 0x452040 (msg 0x66) + 0x451F90 (msg 0x64) on obj+0xCBF+idx*64 (dead: no type-1 dialog exists statically, 24 ctor callers pass no type 1 [EI-287]); else if [obj+0x930]==2 -> MoveWindow(0x8AA48C, [0x8AB7F0]+0x120, [0x8AB7F4]+0x195, 0x4B, 0xD, 1) + ShowWindow + SetFocus (restore chat input); [0x8AA498]=0.
seven_ee_handoff.conclusion: lparam (the typed text/amount at obj+0x130) is NEVER consumed by either 0x7EE receiver; the amount does not leave the client through the 0x7EE message. (At the dispatcher 0x41E522: push edi(wparam); push ebx(lparam); call 0x41CDE0 — wparam=edi, lparam=ebx.)

accept_wire_0x406.accept: 0x417034 (trade accept click, vtable-dispatched, no E8 callers; per EI-287 hit path gold-box 确定 -> confirm 0x418545/0x418648 -> accept) -> 0x451B30(ecx=0x8AB828); sets finalize flag [obj+0x13644]=1 (0x417039).
accept_wire_0x406.sender: 0x451B30: 0x452940(obj+0x18, 0x406, 0, 0, 0, 0) builds the 12-byte header (0x452940 layout: [eax]=dword arg3, [eax+4]=word arg2, [eax+6]=word arg4, [eax+8]=word arg5, [eax+0xA]=word arg6) = bytes 00 00 00 00 06 04 00 00 00 00 00 00: dword0=0 (no amount), word+4=0x406 (message id), three zero words; then 0x451E60(obj, 0).
accept_wire_0x406.wire_builder: 0x451E60: 0x4528E0(header=obj+0x18, obj+0x24, 0x20) copies the 12-byte header into a padded 32-byte buffer obj+0x24 (12 meaningful bytes + 20 zeros); 0x452740 encodes the 32 bytes 6-bit-wise (alphabet offset 0x3C, MIR base64-like) into TEXT; counter [obj+0x14] wraps 9->1 (0x451E7D); arg2==0 -> sprintf(obj+0x2044, 0x47C800 '#%d%s!', counter, obj+0x24); strlen; send(socket=[obj+0x6044], buf=obj+0x2044) via 0x468098. Payload branch (format 0x47C840 '#%d%s%s!', payload -> obj+0x44) is used by other senders (e.g. chat 0x7D1 via 0x451F10), NOT by 0x406.
accept_wire_0x406.conclusion: The accept wire message 0x406 = '#<counter><MIR-encoded 12-byte header {0, 0x406, 0, 0, 0}>!' with ZERO payload. No gold amount field exists on the accept wire.

gold_amount_send_paths.live_0x3F8: 0x41E4xx custom-msg dispatcher (table 0x41E690: 0x7ED->0x41E530, 0x7EE->0x41E522, 0x7EF->0x41E54B, 0x7F0->0x41E56A; dispatch 0x41E50C lea eax,[ebp-0x7ED], cmp 3, jmp [eax*4+0x41E690]): 0x7EE entry 0x41E522 -> 0x41CDE0 with edi=wparam, ebx=lparam. 0x41CDE0: byte2=(wparam>>16)&0xFF switch in 0x64..0x67 (table 0x41CED8 dwords {0x41CE60, 0x41CE14, 0x41CE86, 0x41CEAB}): byte2==0x64 -> case 0x41CE14 (byte0==0; 0x419CC0; msg 0x3F1 send via 0x451660); byte2==0x65 -> case 0x41CE60 (byte0==1; 0x419CC0; SendMessageA(main, 2, 0, 0) via [0x476290]); byte2==0x66 -> case 0x41CE86 (byte0==0; push ebx(lparam); 0x4681F9 number-parse; cmp eax,[esi+0x35B1E8]; jge suppress; push eax; call 0x451940) — THE only static gold-amount send; byte2==0x67 -> case 0x41CEAB (cmp di,0x40E && byte0==0 -> 0x452440), dead (low16==0x40E forces byte0==0x0E); default 0x41CEC2 -> router 0x42D680(ecx=obj+0x2A548C) with wparam=edi, lparam=ebx.
gold_amount_send_paths.sender_0x3F8: 0x451940: 0x452940(obj+0x18, 0x3F8, amount, 0, 0, 0) -> 12-byte header {dword0=amount32, word+4=0x3F8, 0, 0, 0} (0x452940 layout verified: [eax]=dword arg3, [eax+4]=word arg2); 0x451E60(obj, 0) -> wire '#<counter><MIR-encoded header>!'. Amount present ONLY as the 32-bit header dword0; gated by runtime field [obj+0x35B1E8] (per-object, RUNTIME state, outside static scope). Business semantic (trade-gold vs give-gold vs buy-gold) [INFERENCE].
gold_amount_send_paths.dead_0x405: 0x451B00 (sole 0x405 sender: 0x452940(obj+0x18, 0x405, amount, 0, 0, 0) -> {dword0=amount32, word+4=0x405, 0, 0, 0}; sole E8 caller = 0x4172AE inside gate 0x417280). Gate 0x417280: arg1 ax==0x405 AND (arg1>>16)&0xFF==0 (i.e. wparam==0x00000405, byte2==0) -> atoi(arg2) > [0x7DA100] suppresses, else send 0x405. Router 0x42D680 (table 0x42D700 dwords {0x42D6BA, 0x42D6D1, 0x42D6F9, 0x42D6A3, 0x42D6F9, 0x42D6F9, 0x42D6E8}) dispatches byte2-3 in 0..6 (byte2 in 3..9) only: byte2==3 -> 0x42D6BA (ecx+=0x3399C) -> gate 0x417280(wparam, lparam); byte2==4 -> 0x42D6D1 (ecx+=0x4707C) -> 0x425820; byte2==5 -> no-op 0x42D6F9; byte2==6 -> 0x42D6A3 (ecx+=0x47834) -> 0x4247C0; byte2==7,8 -> no-op; byte2==9 -> 0x42D6E8 (ecx+=0x51150) -> 0x4404E0. byte2==0 is NEVER routed -> gate unreachable. Even if reached, [0x7DA100]==0 blocks any positive amount (atoi(amount) > 0 always). DOUBLY DEAD: 0x405 is never sent in this build (confirms EI-288; correction: EI-288's 'category byte 4' — the actual dispatch index is byte2==3, table idx0; conclusion unchanged).
gold_amount_send_paths.chat_router: 0x42D680 callers: 0x41CECA (chat-command default), 0x41D190, 0x41E001 — all in the 0x41xxxx UI-event region; the gate case 0x42D6BA passes ecx=obj+0x3399C (trade window slot per EI-287).

seven_da100_dead_slot.location: 0x7DA100 lies in the virtual-only (loader zero-filled) tail of .data: PE section table shows .data VA 0x47A000, rawsize 0x5000 (file-backed 0x47A000..0x47F000), virtual size 0x49EFD4 (VA 0x47A000..0x518FD4) — every byte above 0x47F000, including 0x7DA100, has NO file-backed image and is zero-filled at load (as are 0x8AA48C/0x8AB7B0/0x8AB828/0x8AA498).
seven_da100_dead_slot.reference_set: Whole-image raw LE-byte scan for 00 A1 7D 00: exactly 2 hits, both reads in .text: 0x41729D (mov ecx,[0x7DA100] inside gate 0x417280) and 0x42EE4C (mov eax,[0x7DA100] bag gold paint). ZERO stores (no A3/89 05/C7 05 imm32 writers) anywhere in the image.

readers.gate: 0x41729B mov ecx,[0x7DA100] (imm32 at 0x41729D); 0x4172A4 cmp eax(atoi(amount)), ecx; jg 0x4172B3 (suppress); else call 0x451B00 at 0x4172AE. With [0x7DA100]==0 any positive amount is suppressed.
readers.bag_paint: 0x42EE4C: sprintf(stack buf, 0x47A214 '%d', [0x7DA100]) -> 0x45DE50 text draw on renderer 0x8AB7A8, font 0x47BE18 (굴림체 CP949; GBK misread 奔覆眉, per EI-288), color 0x64C8F8, rect (x+0x41, y+0x11A)-(x+0x8E, y+0x12B) relative to slot origin [esi+0x18]/[esi+0x1C]; inside the panel draw invoked from 0x426D4D/0x426F97/0x427750/0x42816C.

seven_da100_dead_slot.conclusion: [0x7DA100] == 0 at all times: the bag displays '0' and the 0x405 gate always suppresses. Dead config slot, never wired in this build. Intended semantic [INFERENCE]: unused trade/purchase gold-payment limit (the bound a live gold-pay path would have used; the runtime bound actually used is [obj+0x35B1E8] in the 0x3F8 path).

verdict: The trade-gold amount is typed into the chat input, copied to obj+0x130, and passed to the main window as the 0x7EE lparam — but both 0x7EE receivers ignore it (0x404600 is argument-free; 0x45A140 reads only the wparam type byte), so the amount never leaves the client via that handoff. The trade-accept wire message 0x406 (accept click 0x417034 -> 0x451B30) is header-only: '#<counter><MIR-encoded 12-byte header {dword0=0, word+4=0x406, 0, 0, 0}>!' with zero payload. The only static path that puts a gold amount on the wire is the chat-command case byte2==0x66 in 0x41CDE0 -> msg 0x3F8 (1016) with the amount as the 32-bit header dword0, gated by the runtime bound [obj+0x35B1E8]. The legacy msg 0x405 sender 0x451B00 is reachable only through gate 0x417280, which is doubly dead (wparam byte2==0 requirement vs router byte2 in 3..9 dispatch; plus [0x7DA100]==0 suppresses any positive amount). 0x7DA100 is a loader-zeroed virtual-.data-tail dword with zero writers and exactly two readers (dead gate bound 0x41729D, bag gold paint 0x42EE4C displaying '%d'); it is always 0 — a dead config slot whose intended semantic was an unused trade/purchase gold-payment limit [INFERENCE]. Closes inventory-window-render-evidence.json pending item 1 (semantic name of 0x7DA100) on the static side.

conclusions.claim: The typed trade-gold text is copied to obj+0x130 by the 0x7EE sender 0x4185CB (GetWindowTextA 0x8AA48C -> +0x130, 0x104 bytes) and passed as lparam to the main window 0x8AB7B0; BOTH receivers ignore it — 0x404600 reads no arguments (ret 8; only game state +0x8A4/+0xE3D/+0xD39/+0xD38, calls 0x403640, resets 0x8AA498) and 0x45A140 reads only [esp+4] wparam (type byte 16-23 / arg byte 0-7; lparam untouched). The amount does not leave the client through 0x7EE.

Msg 0x406 (trade accept) wire message is header-only with ZERO payload: 0x417034 -> 0x451B30 -> 0x452940(obj+0x18, 0x406, 0, 0, 0, 0) builds the 12-byte header (layout: [eax]=dword arg3, [eax+4]=word arg2, [eax+6]=word arg4, [eax+8]=word arg5, [eax+0xA]=word arg6) = {dword0=0, word+4=0x406, 0, 0, 0}; 0x451E60 copies it via 0x4528E0 into padded obj+0x24 (12B + 20 zeros), 0x452740 MIR-encodes (6-bit, alphabet +0x3C) into text, sprintf(obj+0x2044, 0x47C800 '#%d%s!', counter, obj+0x24); counter [obj+0x14] wraps 9->1; send via socket [obj+0x6044] -> 0x468098. No gold amount field exists on the accept wire.

The ONLY static path that puts a gold amount on the wire: chat-command handler 0x41CDE0 (dispatched from 0x7EE via 0x41E4xx family dispatcher entry 0x41E522, wparam=edi, lparam=ebx) case byte2==0x66 (0x41CE86, byte0==0): 0x4681F9 number-parse of the lparam text, < [obj+0x35B1E8] gate (jge suppresses), -> 0x451940 -> 0x452940(obj+0x18, 0x3F8, amount, 0, 0, 0) -> header {dword0=amount32, word+4=0x3F8, 0, 0, 0}, no payload, wire '#<counter><encoded header>!'; bound is runtime state [INFERENCE on business semantic: trade/give/buy gold].

Msg 0x405 is NEVER sent in this build (confirms EI-288 with a table-index correction): sole sender 0x451B00 (0x452940(obj+0x18, 0x405, amount, 0, 0, 0) -> header {dword0=amount32, word+4=0x405, 0, 0, 0}); sole E8 caller 0x4172AE inside gate 0x417280, which requires wparam==0x00000405 (byte2==0) while its only dispatch path (router 0x42D680, table 0x42D700 dwords {0x42D6BA, 0x42D6D1, 0x42D6F9, 0x42D6A3, 0x42D6F9, 0x42D6F9, 0x42D6E8}: byte2==3->gate 0x42D6BA, 4->0x425820, 5->no-op, 6->0x4247C0, 7/8->no-op, 9->0x4404E0) can never produce byte2==0 — and even if reached, [0x7DA100]==0 makes atoi(amount)>0 always suppress.

0x7DA100 is a dead config slot: virtual-only .data tail (PE: .data VA 0x47A000, rawsize 0x5000 -> file-backed ends 0x47F000; virtual size 0x49EFD4 -> tail 0x47F000..0x518FD4 loader zero-filled), whole-image imm32 scan = exactly 2 hits, both reads (0x41729B mov ecx,[0x7DA100], imm32 at 0x41729D, dead gate bound; 0x42EE4C bag gold paint sprintf '%d' 0x47A214, font 굴림체 0x47BE18, color 0x64C8F8, rect (x+0x41,y+0x11A)-(x+0x8E,y+0x12B)), zero writers anywhere -> always 0 -> bag shows '0' and the gate always suppresses. Intended semantic [INFERENCE]: unused trade/purchase gold-payment limit (never wired; the live 0x3F8 path uses the runtime bound [obj+0x35B1E8] instead).

Chat-command cases other than 0x66 are no-ops or dead: byte2==0x64 -> case 0x41CE14 (byte0==0; 0x419CC0; msg 0x3F1 send 0x451660); byte2==0x65 -> case 0x41CE60 (byte0==1; 0x419CC0; SendMessageA(main, 2, 0, 0)); byte2==0x67 -> case 0x41CEAB '0x40E' is dead (requires byte0==0 while low16==0x040E forces byte0==0x0E); byte2 outside 0x64..0x67 falls to the router 0x42D680.

Alignment: consistent with EI-288 (0x405 no live sender; 0x406 via 0x451B30 live; 0x7DA100 zero writers) and EI-284/EI-287 (gold box relative rect (0x22,0x10E)..(0x9C,0x130) = (34,270)-(156,304); input dialog 0x418030(0x7E04C8, 0x565994, 3, 1, prompt 0x47AD98 "你要给对方多少金币?", 1, -1, -1, tag 0x405); confirm 0x418545/0x418648 -> 0x417034 -> 0x451B30; finalize [0x13644]=1). The stored 0x405 is a dialog TAG, never transmitted as a wire message.

2026-08-11: inventory-window-render-evidence.json pending item 1 (semantic name of 0x7DA100): static side CLOSED by EI-295 (trade-gold-flow-evidence.json). The complete outbound gold flow is traced: 0x7EE handoff ignores the amount text (0x404600 arg-less, 0x45A140 wparam-only); accept msg 0x406 is header-only with no payload; msg 0x405 sender is doubly dead; the only live gold-amount path is msg 0x3F8 (32-bit header dword0, runtime bound [obj+0x35B1E8]). 0x7DA100 has zero writers and two readers (dead gate bound, bag gold paint) and is loader-zeroed -> always 0 -> dead config slot; intended semantic = unused trade/purchase gold-payment limit [INFERENCE]. Runtime packet trace of msgs 0x3F8/0x405/0x406 and the [obj+0x35B1E8] updater remains out of static scope (KEPT-runtime).
